prompt: Professional premium rigid packaging photography, one CONSISTENT product in a strict 3-column 2-row contact sheet, 3:2 overall. Six equal square cells, no borders/captions/text/logo. Cell6 blank. Product Brooch keepsake, Shoulder-neck box. A removable lid fits over a raised inner neck, leaving a narrow shoulder band. Paper-wrapped rigid greyboard, Smooth matte printed wrapping paper, Plum and pearl, Blind embossed motif and small foil accent, fine abstract wave pattern. EMPTY insert: one shallow padded brooch recess. Cell1 CLOSED full 3/4 hero. Cell2 OPEN: Detached lid rests flat RIGHT of base separated by a wide gap; raised inner neck clearly visible. No hinge. Cell3 closed rear/side same design. Cell4 overhead close view of the SAME empty insert inside base. Cell5 close paper/finish/corner detail. All views same proportions, artwork locations, number and shape of insert cavities. Neutral warm studio, tactile paper, refined controlled lighting. Never a corrugated mailer, tuck carton, dust flaps or shipping box. Realistic separate assembled rigid walls, straight edges, accurate mating footprints and visible paper thickness. Keep complete objects within each cell. No products inside; focus on the packaging. In detachable structures never prop the lid against the base or stand it behind it; rest it flat alongside with a clear empty gap.
reviewNotes: Five views visually reviewed for opening, insert layout and finish continuity; physical sampling still required.
